block-definition.comment: Create a presentation. Specify a default layout for the whole deck. For each slide expand another C-shaped input slot to hold a script to be executed when the slide is presented. For static slides you can use a "slide" command, and combine it with other blocks and sprites for animated or interactive elements. For standard next / back button controls use the "buttons" command. Alternatively you can also create your own controls instead of the standard ones.
Writes text onto the stage, and allows extra styling. You don't have to add stats. Created by Tethrarxitet! pic goes hard feel free to screenshot
